basic_details.job_title: WB Police Basirhat Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: West Bengal Police Basirhat (WB Police Basirhat) has invited applications for 8 posts of Driver (Contractual Basis) under Advt No. 4381/E/2026/HA. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.
basic_details.job_location: North Twenty Four Parganas, West Bengal

age_limit.age_details: 21 to 40 years (as on the date of publication of the advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Minimum Class VIII pass from a recognised school, with ability to read and write Bengali, and valid driving licence for LMV or HMV.
qualification.details: Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India and a permanent resident of West Bengal Applicants must provide a valid mobile number in the application form

how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official websites of West Bengal Police or Basirhat Police District.
Print the application form on white A4-size paper and fill it in BLOCK / CAPITAL LETTERS.
Affix one recent passport-size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm) duly self-attested at the top-right corner.

Enclose self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Driving Licence, Experience Certificate, educational certificates, Birth Certificate, and motor vehicle repairing certificates if applicable.
Submit the completed application form along with requisite documents in the Drop Box (not by post) at the Office of the Superintendent of Police, Basirhat Police District.
Superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER (CONTRACTUAL BASIS), 2026".
Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.
important_instructions: No application fees will be charged from the candidates for the recruitment process. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending the Driving Test and Interview.

Superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER (CONTRACTUAL BASIS), 2026". Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India and a permanent resident of West Bengal. Applicants must provide a valid mobile number in the application form.
